build_sphinx_documentation: run the SphinxDocumentation command to generate HTML documentation from the gRPC Python Sphinx source directory
build_project_metadata: run the BuildProjectMetadata command to generate the grpcio version metadata module file
cythonize_extensions: run try_cythonize on a list of distutils Extension objects to generate C files from Cython sources
build_extensions: run the BuildExt command to compile C and C++ extensions with compiler-specific flags and Cython support
gather_dependencies: run the Gather command to fetch install or test dependencies for the grpcio distribution
